prompts: Create a finished horizontal hero illustration for an AI B-Roll upload dialog in a premium video editing web app. Wide 2:1 composition, transparent alpha background outside four rounded photographic cards and one small connecting arrow. No words, letters, captions, logos, watermark, UI controls, or surrounding app mockup. At left, one small vertical rounded video thumbnail: photorealistic East Asian female coffee creator aged around 30 in a simple muted charcoal shirt, speaking naturally to camera at a warm coffee studio table, a discreet lavalier microphone, head and torso visible. In the center a simple small matte gray rightward arrow. At right, a larger group of THREE tall rounded photographic video thumbnails, slightly overlapping but all clearly visible: close-up coffee beans falling from a hand into a ceramic bowl; close-up a gooseneck kettle pouring water over a paper coffee filter; close-up steam rising from a finished ivory ceramic coffee cup held by a hand. These are alternate shots from the SAME coffee studio, coordinated warm wood, muted sage, cream, amber coffee tones and softly lit realistic photography. Tell the visual story of a creator's original talking-head clip supplemented with their own related footage. Left card occupies about 22 percent of width, arrow 9 percent, right group 55 percent, generous breathing space. Left card 65 percent height of right cards, all vertically centered. Rounded corners of about 20px at 1536px canvas width; premium subtle depth and soft restrained shadow, no heavy outlines or artificial glow. Imagery rich and crisp enough to read at 450px wide. Fill around 90 percent of width and 80 percent of height with balanced margins. The final output is one standalone production-ready illustration, landscape, NOT an icon, NOT an infographic, NOT a collage of unrelated fantasy scenes. Transparent background must remain transparent.

Edit this illustration for production use on a dark app dialog. Preserve exactly the four photographic panels, their contents, rounded corners, and their relative arrangement. REMOVE ALL background imagery, blur, haze, gradients and glow outside the four rounded panels: outside the panels must be genuinely transparent alpha, not painted black, not checkerboard, not a blurry backdrop. Keep a single simple slim gray rightward arrow between the left portrait and right footage cards. Make the arrow clearly visible on dark charcoal. No outline strokes on panels. Keep shadows only as tiny subtle contact shadows within 8 pixels of panel edges. Output a clean standalone transparent PNG, retain the same aspect ratio. No text or extra decorations.

Keep the four photographic panels and the arrow exactly as they are. Replace ALL checkerboard and all surrounding background, including any gray wisps and shadows, with a perfectly flat solid dark charcoal RGB(20,20,20), hex #141414. No transparency, no checkerboard, no gradient, no blur, no halo, no glow. The background must be one single uniform dark charcoal color everywhere outside the panels and arrow. Preserve panel contents unchanged. This is a flat-background web dialog hero, not a transparency preview.
